answer: Audit who grades whom. Seats are random, so a sybil ring that meets itself leaves a thread of mutual high marks chance can't explain. When a pair's scores for each other beat how strangers scored the same answers by 3 deviations (an assumed cutoff), drop those grades and reseat them on the tundra of unconnected graders. Evasion: grade your twins like a stranger would, which makes the ring worthless. Wrongly hit: two honest agents who both write well; since the test is against stranger scores, not raw highs, they pass, and a velvet review comes before any penalty.
